svg.aria-label: Not converted to SVG. The headline is set on a tilted banner, rotated roughly ten degrees across the poster, and the solver only measures horizontal baselines. It never finds those letters at all: the band it takes for the headline is a cap-65 line elsewhere on the page, so the copy shifts up by one and the presenter is set across the top at display size, colliding with everything under it. Reset horizontally the poster would also lose the diagonal that is the whole composition. A rotated headline is reproducible in principle -- an SVG can carry a rotate transform -- but nothing in the pipeline measures the angle, so this is a limit of the tooling rather than of the poster.
svg.title: Not converted to SVG — neue_sachlichkeit — gig poster
